lane: B1: TA-learned copy selector at full data (docs/13 A4 H9.1, H9.2; gate G1 T2)
status: confirmatory input (pair stores); no hypothesis is judged in this run; validation only, the test split is never loaded
docs: docs/11 section 11 (11.4 buckets, 11.5 sparse normaliser, 11.6 protocol); docs/12 F19, F20; docs/13 A4 (H' residues: 1 trains the T2 clauses, 2 selection, temperature and mixture weights; T2 inputs use a KN-5 fitted without H')

build.note: 3 forked workers over disjoint position ranges (per-pair results do not depend on the split); peaks are the expected anonymous memory of each phase for the lane memory rule

params.base_hprime: frozen EM weights of the L0 core over the suffix clauses of kn5_noHprime.npz (the cache group hprime base); every H' core row is checked bit for bit against the cache (gold entry, top-64)
params.base_validation: the frozen CVTM-core cvtm_core.npz (state hash above); rows checked bit for bit against the cache
params.candidates: the 1024 most recent distinct tokens that occurred earlier in the same document (recency order); label = candidate equals the next token
params.literals: the 237 literals of experiments/cvtm_early_logical_attention.py (literal_spec, literal_tables, imported) over 29 pair features; base B of that script = the core here (P_core, its rank, P_S of its suffix clauses, its cluster masses, its k*, the highest firing D_m); frequency classes from the token counts of the training split without H'

groups.r1: every position of the H' residue-1 documents (t2_train): all positive pairs, and a Bernoulli(0.01) pool of the negative pairs keyed by mix64 of (stable document ID, offset, candidate)
groups.s2a: S2 = 1 in 8 positions of the H' residue-2 documents (selection): h = mix64(mix64(doc_id XOR 0x5E1EC7102) + offset), h mod 8 == 0; S2a = the S2 positions with bit 3 of h equal to 0: every configuration of every gate is scored here
groups.s2b: the S2 positions with bit 3 of h equal to 1: used, together with S2a, only to fit the read-out of the chosen configuration of each gate
groups.val: every validation position; all pairs with P_core of every candidate and the packed literal columns

launch: scripts/cpu_slot.sh 3 -- nice -n 10 .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --no-gpu-sampler --name cvtm_copy_selector_pairs --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_copy_selector_pairs.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_copy_selector.py build --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_copy_selector_pairs.json
compute_cap: about 1 hour on 3 CPU slots; no GPU
